prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a substantially more realistic studio catalog PHOTOGRAPH of the Northstar Half Rack using the attached image ONLY as a reference for overall equipment structure. The last attempt was rejected because it looked like CGI and had large garish orange blocks. This must be a visibly different photographic treatment, not a near-identical recolor.

Keep the half rack design: exactly two tall perforated square steel uprights, open front, top crossmember and straight pull-up bar, two J-cups, two projecting safety arms, two long floor rails, rear diagonal braces and low rear crossmember. Similar overall proportions (122cm wide, 130cm deep, 215cm high), full product in front three-quarter view. Do not add tall rear posts, cage, weights, barbell, bench or accessories.

CHANGE THE COLOR DISTRIBUTION decisively: at least 95 percent of visible equipment is charcoal / satin black steel. ALL large top brackets are charcoal black. ALL J-cup bodies are charcoal black with black polymer liners. ALL long safety-arm bodies and their upright mounting sleeves are charcoal black, with black protective upper liners. Orange must be confined to two very small thin inset accent plates on the outer tips of the two safety arms, in a muted burnt-orange / copper-orange powder coat. Orange is a quiet tiny detail, never a dominant surface. No bright orange blocks, no orange top brackets, no orange long rails.

Make it look like an actual manufactured rack photographed in a studio: convincing thickness of bent steel plates, fine understated powder-coat texture (not coarse procedural noise), modest welds at joints, blackened or zinc steel fasteners, recessed dark holes with actual depth, real satin specular reflections from a large rectangular softbox. Natural local light falloff, soft fill on the shadow side, crisp but not razor-outlined edges, realistic dark contact shadows where parts meet. Black steel should have deep charcoal tones rather than uniformly grey computer-render shading. High-end full-frame product photograph, 70mm lens, f/8, true optical perspective. Clean new condition without rust, dirt or fake damage.

Photograph against a clean neutral off-white seamless studio floor and backdrop, subtle softbox reflection and gentle floor shadow, no dramatic environment. Whole product visible, centered in a square image with margins on all sides. Restrained exposure and contrast, natural white balance. No text, logos, labels, watermark, people, room furniture, measurements. Avoid CGI, CAD visualization, game assets, cartoon, plastic toy materials, uniform ambient lighting, gritty noise, HDR, oversharpened outlines. Output one high-resolution square image.
review: Visually inspected: two-upright open half-rack structure retained, large attachments now charcoal, orange reduced to narrow accents on two spotter tips. Darker satin steel and softer studio background. AI-generated catalog illustration, not a real product photograph.
status: Accepted by the user and copied to public/assets/northstar-half-rack-catalog.png on 2026-08-31; existing application references now serve this variant. GLB unchanged.
